a. 一打的
dozen.d:
n the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one
s denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units

dozer.t: n. 打瞌睡的人, 推土机
dozer.d: n large powerful tractor; a large blade in front flattens areas of ground

dozing.t: v. 打盹儿, 打瞌睡( doze的现在分词 )
dozing.d: v sleep lightly or for a short period of time
